'''Ulmatra''' was a minor [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located within the [[Ulmatra system/Legends|Ulmatra system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region. It lay at the intersection of the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']] and [[the Dead Road]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. The former connected Ulmatra to the planets [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] and [[Randa/Legends|Randa]], while the latter linked the planet to the worlds of [[Kafane]] and [[Zisia]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ulmatra was home to the creature known as the [[Ulmatran condor]],<ref name="TCWCharEncyclopedia" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> and the planet lay within the sphere of influence of the [[Kajidier]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], a clan of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LoNH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Cleanest Profession" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Ulmatra housed hundreds of corporations that were suspected of [[Currency/Legends|money]] laundering. An individual visited Ulmatra at that [[Time/Legends|time]] and [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the corporations' [[Computer/Legends|computers]] in order to find out which businesses laundered [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The slicer discovered that several of the corporations laundered money for the criminal organization known as the [[Exchange]] and was generously rewarded for that information by the Hutts.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|The Cleanest Profession}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Others were meant to sound like they were named by other species &ndash; Affavan and Ulmatra, for instance.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
Ulmatra was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the planet in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu]], Fry noted that the name of Ulmatra was intended to sound as if it had been named by a species other than the Hutts.<ref name="Suvudu" /> Ulmatra was mentioned in a Slicing Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
